title: Release, Compliance Holds and Provider Credits on Mobile Wallet Transfers
content:
Payments operations chapter for the **Mobile Wallet** product.

## Release and the first credit
A transfer is released once its principal is collected (or the ACH principal is released early within the account's allowance) and any new-recipient cooling-off has run. Release sends the first credit, credit attempt 1, at the transfer's exchange rate and records the release moment.

## Provider rejections
- A credit the provider cannot complete for a technical reason (rejection reason "provider unavailable") is re-sent automatically up to the tier's number of automatic re-sends, the tier's interval apart, before it is treated as failed.
- Any other rejection (wallet limit exceeded, wallet not registered, wallet name mismatch, wallet number invalid, wallet suspended) fails the credit at once: the principal comes back in full and the transfer becomes credit failed, handled under the Mobile Wallet failed-credit terms.

## Compliance holds and requests for information
- Compliance may hold a transfer before or during processing. A hold whose reason is a transfer-level request for information asks the customer for information.
- An answer is logged only while the transfer is on hold with that hold reason; the status and hold reason are read from the transfer's system record.
- Each upload reference is logged once; an upload reference already logged as an answer is not logged again.
- Only compliance releases a hold, within the tier's hold review period in Paloma business days of a complete answer, and the date available is then re-disclosed from the release.
- A held transfer is cancelled by Paloma when its request for information goes unanswered for more than the tier's answer period in calendar days after the hold was placed, or when compliance rejects it.

## Credit confirmed
When the provider confirms the credit the transfer is credited, earning Paloma Rewards points.

## Logging an answer: points of judgement (hypothetical)

| Transfer status | Hold reason | Upload reference already logged | Answer logged |
|---|---|---|---|
| on hold | request for information on the transfer | no | yes |
| on hold | request for information on the transfer | yes | no |
| on hold | another hold reason | no | no |
| processing | none | no | no |
